channel.title: Joel Cook
channel.description: What I built, what it saved, and what broke along the way.

item.title: Search: 48% more accurate, 26% faster, 29% cheaper
item.description: I trained a search model for RiverGuide and measured it against the keyword search it replaced, on 523 real student questions and RiverGuide’s 54-question test.
item.author: joeltcook93@gmail.com (Joel Cook)

item.title: RiverGuide 2 searches the college’s own 2,389 pages
item.description: One copy of the facts instead of a wiki. A $5 Cloudflare plan took the first live score from 14 to 41 of 54, and off-the-shelf embeddings tied keyword search.
item.author: joeltcook93@gmail.com (Joel Cook)

item.title: 946,091 document records sorted in-house, not by a $600,000 contract
item.description: Every document record moved from Workday to Banner by rules the record owners signed off on. When the evidence conflicted, the record went to Legacy instead of a guess.
item.author: joeltcook93@gmail.com (Joel Cook)

item.title: Hosting: $50,000 down to $8,000
item.description: 84% off the bill for a website with 250,000 visitors a month. The next step, moving it on premises, isn’t approved yet.
item.author: joeltcook93@gmail.com (Joel Cook)

item.title: Our giving site was hacked. A leftover API token kept the attacker in.
item.description: The patch and a new hosting password didn’t lock the attacker out. Revoking one full-access API token did.
item.author: joeltcook93@gmail.com (Joel Cook)

item.title: RiverGuide: 9,000+ chats a week, $47,000 a year less
item.description: The college’s student assistant answers in students’ own words, looks up every fact that changes, and is graded on 53 test cases.
item.author: joeltcook93@gmail.com (Joel Cook)
